# S. Saktheeswaran (Sakthi)

> S. Saktheeswaran (Sakthi) is a digital marketing and SEO expert from Tamil Nadu, India, and the founder & CEO of Astra Nexora (https://astranexora.netlify.app/), a digital marketing agency founded in 2025. He works on SEO and local SEO, websites, Google and Meta ads, n8n and WhatsApp automation and social media creatives.

- Portfolio: https://saktheeswaran.netlify.app/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/saktheeswaran-digital-marketing-expert/
- Email: saktheesw2005@gmail.com
- Location: Tamil Nadu, India (works with clients across India)
